keyword: can i file taxes on april 15
claims: April 15 is the official due date for individual tax returns.
Individual tax returns must be submitted online or postmarked by midnight in your time zone to be considered on time.
Taxpayers who owe money must pay by April 15 to avoid interest and penalties.
Form 4868 can be filed by April 15 for an automatic six-month extension until Oct. 15.
An extension gives more time to file, not more time to pay taxes owed.
If you miss the April 15 deadline and owe tax, penalties can reach 5% per month of the unpaid tax.
